title: Ave mater matris Dei (Bologna Q19) (Jachet)
desc: Jachet of Mantua, Ave mater matris Dei (Bologna Q19). 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus I, Bassus II), each on its own staff. Source: Bologna Q19. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
